hook: If you flew past Io, you'd see eruptions.
title: Jupiter's Moon Is Covered in Erupting Volcanoes
description:
Io, a moon of Jupiter, is the most volcanically active body in the Solar System. Spacecraft have photographed its plumes blasting hundreds of kilometres above the surface. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #Jupiter
